title: Trainee People & Culture / HR (m/w/d)
description: #keepquestioning Du begeisterst dich für Human Resources und möchtest People-Themen und die Unternehmenskultur in einem mittelständischen Medien- und Weiterbildungsunternehmen mit ca. 150 Mitarbeitenden aktiv mitgestalten? Du willst als Teil unseres 3-köpfigen People & Culture-Teams Prozesse smarter machen, Mitarbeitende entlang ihres gesamten Employee Life Cycles begleiten und dabei Schritt für Schritt in die Rolle hineinwachsen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als Trainee People & Culture / HR (m/w/d) . Deine Verantwortung Du unterstützt als Ansprechperson unsere Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycles (Onboarding bis Offboarding) und übernimmst hier zunehmend eigene Themen und deinen eigenen Mitarbeitendenstamm. Du lernst alle relevanten HR-Prozesse kennen, hilfst mit, sie zu optimieren, und bringst eigene Ideen zum Einsatz von KI-Tools ein. Du betreust eigene Stellen im Recruiting-Prozess – von der Erstellung der Stellenausschreibung bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag – und trägst so zu einer positiven Candidate Experience bei. Dabei entwickelst du gemeinsam mit dem Team kreative Wege, um passende Kandidat:innen zu gewinnen - auch per Active Sourcing. Du unterstützt bei der internen Unternehmenskommunikation und der Organisation interner Veranstaltungen, hilfst mit, P&C-Themen sichtbar zu machen, und bringst eigene Impulse für die Unternehmenskultur ein. Deine Skills Du hast dein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich (z. B. Wirtschafts-, Sozial- oder Geisteswissenschaften mit HR-Bezug) abgeschlossen - oder dein Abschluss steht unmittelbar bevor. Du bringst mindestens ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit im Bereich HR, People & Culture oder Personalverwaltung mit. Du zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Ausdrucksstärke aus und hast große Freude am Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Kolleg:innen. Du bringst einen starken Teamgeist, Neugier und Lust mit, Prozesse mit- und neuzugestalten - idealerweise bist du außerdem affin für digitale Tools und hast erste Erfahrungen mit KI-Anwendungen. Du legst eine strukturierte, organisierte Arbeitsweise, ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten und ein lösungsorientiertes Mindset an den Tag. Du bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht mit und bist motiviert, dein Wissen hier kontinuierlich auszubauen und auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten. Du verfügst über exzellente Deutsch- und mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse. Erzähl uns, wer du bist. Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und dein frühestes Startdatum. Nicht alle oben genannten Punkte treffen auf dich zu, du kannst dir jedoch vorstellen, mit deinen Skills und deiner Persönlichkeit unser Team zu bereichern? Bewirb dich gern - wir sind immer auf der Suche nach motivierten Talenten. Wir melden uns schnellstmöglich bei dir zurück. Bitte teile uns mit, sofern du eine geschlechtsneutrale Ansprache wünschst. Unsere Rahmenbedingungen für dich als Trainee: Dauer: Die Dauer des Traineeships umfasst 18 Monate. Umfang: Du unterstützt uns mit 40 Stunden pro Woche. Vergütung: Zusätzlich zu einer fairen Vergütung bekommst du von uns ein BVG-Ticket und wir ermöglichen dir deine gezielte Weiterbildung im Bereich People Management / People & Culture / HR. Unsere Benefits Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsbeginn, deine Pause und deinen Feierabend flexibel um unsere Kernarbeitszeit von 10-15 Uhr. Hybrides Arbeiten: Nutze die Möglichkeit, bis zu 2 Tage pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten. Urlaub, Flexity Tage und Workation: Erhole dich an 30 bezahlten Urlaubstagen im Kalenderjahr bei einer 5-Tage-Woche. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, 10 unbezahlte Urlaubstage zu nutzen. Mit unserem Workation-Modell kannst du außerdem bis zu 2 Wochen im Jahr innerhalb der EU aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Weiterbildungen: Ganz nach unserem Motto #keepquestioning fördern wir dich in deiner Rolle mit 5 Weiterbildungstagen im Jahr. Wir möchten dich in deiner beruflichen Entwicklung dabei unterstützen, deine Skills auszubauen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Teamatmosphäre: Sei Teil eines motivierten, herzlichen Teams aus über 150 Mitarbeitenden und erlebe regelmäßige Afterworks, Teamevents und gemeinsame Unternehmungen. Chancengleichheit: Eine offene, tolerante und herzliche Umgebung und gleiche Chancen für alle Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen - unabhängig vom Geschlecht, Aussehen, Alter, ethnischem Hintergrund und Religion. Kurze Wege und flache Hierarchien: Erlebe bei uns eine Arbeitsatmosphäre auf Augenhöhe, kurze Kommunikationswege und Duz-Kultur. Mitwirken und Teilnahme an Fachtagungen und Kongressen: Erweitere dein Wissen und Netzwerk durch dein Mitwirken und die Teilnahme an unseren renommierten Veranstaltungen, wie zum Beispiel dem Personalmanagementkongress, dem Kommunikationskongress oder der KI-X. Internes Sportprogramm und Kooperation mit Urban Sports Club: Nutze unsere vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club und bleibe aktiv mit unserem vielfältigen internen Sportangebot (z.B. Yoga, Beach-Volleyball und Teilnahme an Firmenläufen). Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Sorge für deine Zukunft vor mit der Möglichkeit der Bezuschussung einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Fühl dich wohl und sei du selbst: Bei uns zählt der Mensch, nicht das Outfit. Komm so, wie du dich wohlfühlst. Lage im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung: Erreiche uns bequem mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln und genieße die pulsierende Atmosphäre der Hauptstadt. Modernes begrüntes Office mit Innenhof: Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld mit viel Tageslicht, einer Vielfalt an Pflanzen im Office und in unserem sonnigen Innenhof sowie einem Angebot an frischem Obst, Getränken und Snacks. Bitte beachte: Wir benutzen im Recruiting-Prozess punktuell unterstützend KI. Dabei halten wir uns selbstverständlich an den geltenden Rahmen des EU-AI Acts - die entscheidende Instanz ist immer ein Mensch und keine KI. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Data Scientist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace &amp; defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy &amp; renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><div>&nbsp;</div> <h3><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h3> <div>As a Data Scientist in Delivery, you are a problem solver and builder who is passionate about creating practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, and you excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to transform cutting edge AI models into tools that are useful and used.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>You’ve worked on difficult problems that require strong foundations in data driven modelling and deep learning techniques, with hands-on experience in probabilistic methods and predictive modelling. Expertise in python, along with proficiency in libraries like NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, TensorFlow and PyTorch, is essential, with the ability to deploy scalable, production-ready models and data pipelines.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>With at least 1 year industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you’re ready to hit the ground running. You’re truly excited about growing your technical expertise and are naturally inclined to take ownership of data science work streams, continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving needs of our customers.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <h3><strong>This Role</strong></h3> <div>In this role, you’ll work closely with our Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and customers to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving.</div> <div>You’ll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div> <ul> <li>Pre-processing and analyzing data to prepare it for use in predictive modelling, building the foundation for machine learning algorithms Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex.

What You’ll Do

  • Core data modelling: Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on.

  • Modelling at source: Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse.

  • Pipelines: Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably.

  • Self-serve platform: Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you.

  • Agents as consumers: Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale.

  • Metrics that matter: Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance.

  • Answers, not just queries: Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer.

  • Standards: Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex.

What we’re looking for

  • You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale.

  • You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business.

  • Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it.

    • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

    • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

title: Principal / Lead Primary Engineer - HV Substations
description: <p><strong>Help Shape the Future of the UK's Energy Infrastructure</strong></p> <p>BakerHicks has established itself as a trusted engineering partner within the UK's Transmission &amp; Distribution sector, delivering major infrastructure projects for some of the country's leading utility clients. With continued growth and a strong pipeline of secured work, we are seeking an experienced <strong>Principal/Lead Primary Design Engineer - HV Substations</strong> to join our expanding Power team.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical energy infrastructure projects, leading technical excellence across complex HV substation designs up to 400kV.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the HV Substation Team Leader, you will lead a team of Primary Design Engineers and CAD Technicians, ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality engineering solutions and technical documentation.</p> <p>You will provide technical leadership across HV substation projects, support the development of junior engineers, and act as a key point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will also support business development activities by contributing technical input to tender submissions and helping secure future project opportunities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why This Role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work on some of the UK's most significant Transmission &amp; Distribution projects.</li> <li>Be part of a business that is helping deliver the infrastructure required for the UK's energy transition.</li> <li>Lead and mentor a growing team of engineers and technicians.</li> <li>Work closely with major utility clients including National Grid, SSEN, Scottish Power, UKPN, ENWL and others.</li> <li>Enjoy genuine opportunities for career progression, technical leadership and professional development.</li> <li>Collaborate within a multidisciplinary engineering environment where innovation and new ideas are actively encouraged.</li> <li>See projects progress through the full lifecycle, from concept and design through to construction and energisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the delivery of primary engineering design for HV substation projects up to 400kV.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of engineers and CAD technicians.</li> <li>Ensure the quality, accuracy and consistency of project deliverables.</li> <li>Support and develop junior engineers through coaching and technical guidance.</li> <li>Provide technical oversight and approval of engineering work.</li> <li>Take ownership of HV Plant CDAE responsibilities on National Grid projects where applicable.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Design &amp; Engineering</strong></p> <p>Prepare, review and approve:</p> <ul> <li>Primary layouts and elevations.</li> <li>Single Line Diagrams (SLDs).</li> <li>Transformer sizing and specifications.</li> <li>GIS and AIS switchgear designs.</li> <li>Shunt reactors, NERs and reactive/capacitive compensation schemes.</li> <li>Switchroom layouts.</li> <li>CT sizing calculations.</li> <li>Busbar design and short-circuit force calculations.</li> <li>Busbar and connector specifications.</li> <li>LVAC systems for substations.</li> <li>Earthing studies and earth return current calculations.</li> <li>Insulation coordination studies.</li> <li>Mechanical interlocking schemes.</li> <li>Equipment technical specifications.</li> <li>Type registration documentation.</li> <li>Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Project Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage programme, budget and quality requirements for engineering deliverables.</li> <li>Prepare, review and approve feasibility studies, outline designs, detailed designs and technical reports.</li> <li>Review and approve construction drawings and technical documentation.</li> <li>Coordinate internal teams and external suppliers.</li> <li>Support bid and tender submissions.</li> <li>Maintain updates to the Business Development Tracker.</li> <li>Participate in client meetings, design reviews and technical workshops.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About You:</strong></p> <p>You will be an experienced HV Substation Engineer with a strong technical background and a passion for delivering high-quality engineering solutions.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience delivering primary design and engineering for HV substation projects up to 400kV.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of UK Transmission and Distribution standards and specifications.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Experience leading engineering teams and reviewing technical deliverables.</li> <li>The ability to work independently while supporting and developing others.</li> <li>A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>BEng or BSc in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.</li> <li>Extensive experience in HV substation primary design and engineering.</li> <li>Experience producing designs, calculations, reports and drawings associated with substation projects up to 400kV.</li> <li>Strong understanding of IEC standards and industry best practice.</li> <li>Experience working to National Grid and DNO specifications.</li> <li>Experience managing engineering teams and coordinating project delivery.</li> <li>Experience working alongside CAD technicians using AutoCAD, Revit or similar software.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Desirable Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>MEng or MSc in Electrical Engineering.</li> <li>National Grid HV Plant CDAE accreditation.</li> <li>Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or actively working towards chartership.</li> <li>Experience supporting bids, tenders and work-winning activities.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Join Us</strong></p> <p>This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong HV Substation Engineer looking to take the next step in their career, working on The role will represent RA on multidisciplinary product development subteams and Global Regulatory Team. Additional responsibilities include involvement in the writing and oversight of regulatory submissions, coordinating all aspects of paper and electronic regulatory submissions, proactively keeping updated on EU regulatory requirements, and interpreting regulatory intelligence for the internal teams.</p> <p><strong>Summary of Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as EU Regional Lead for assigned program (s); additional responsibilities may include serving as as Regulatory Program Lead (leading the Global Regulatory Team), for one of the early programs in the Alnylam pipeline.</li> <li>Work with the Global Regulatory Lead and Regulatory Affairs management to lead and define regulatory strategy and to compile and submit, in a timely manner, regulatory documents according to regulatory requirements and lead EU HA interactions. Regulatory documents may include the relevant forms, meeting requests, Briefing Documents for HA meetings, new Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs), Marketing Applications, Paediatric Plans, Orphan Designation and Expedited Pathway Applications (e.g. PRIME), and any amendments.</li> <li>Develop detailed regulatory strategy and project plans and support regulatory activities relating to specific portfolio of products/projects.</li> <li>Serve as member of the Global Regulatory Team, may serve as Regulatory representative in multidisciplinary product subteams or core team for assigned programs and participate as an active team member to provide strategic regulatory advice in relation to EU regulatory activities.</li> <li>Coordinate responses to regulatory authorities’ questions with strict adherence to deadlines.</li> <li>Serve as a liaison within internal departments at Alnylam, with CROs and with regulatory program managers at HAs.</li> <li>Maintain regulatory files in a format consistent with internal requirements.</li> <li>Facilitate as necessary the review of technical regulatory documentation and recommend changes to documentation or processes, including SOPs for regulatory compliance.</li> <li>Provide EU specific regulatory intelligence to internal stakeholders as appropriate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree with 6 or more years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs role; minimum of 8 years’ experience working in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry. Higher degree would be a plus.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills.</li> <li>Solid understanding of regulations and experience in interpretation of guidelines.</li> <li>Ability to think strategically and to proactively identify issues and mitigation strategies in various aspects of the drug development process.</li> <li>Experience with regulatory filings, including electronic submissions, e.g., CTAs, post-marketing variations, safety reporting, paediatric plans, PRIME etc.</li> <ul> <li>MAA filing and Type II variation experience is preferred.</li> </ul> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills; demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple projects.</li> <li>Ability to work in a team environment, possessing interpersonal skills to work effectively with other departments at various levels and with CROs and external consultants.</li> <li>Technical system skills (e.g. word processing, spreadsheets, databases, online research) including submission-ready formatting.</li> <li>Clear alignment with Alnylam Core Values including:</li> <ul> <li>Commitment to People,</li> <li>Fiercely Innovative,</li> <li>Purposeful Urgency,</li> <li>Open Culture, and</li> <li>Passion for Excellence.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>About Alnylam:&nbsp;</strong>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 

What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production?

The role

The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business.

This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story.

You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients.

This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win.

 

Key areas of responsibility

  • Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation
  • Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout
  • Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver
  • Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses
  • Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content
  • Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings
  • Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities
  • Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated
  • Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities
  • Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing

 

  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive
  • Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs
  • Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses
  • Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end
  • Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously
  • Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes
  • Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response
  • Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem
  • Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation

At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

title: Delivery Manager Genflex
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required. Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules. Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective. Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early. Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition. Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next. Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery. Review and interpret customer technical documentation including: Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) Network and communications diagrams Site and asset specifications PPC and controller documentation Modbus register maps IP addressing and network information Functional Design Specifications Metering and telemetry information Hardware and connectivity requirements Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together. Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker. Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information. Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready. Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including: Gateway installation and connectivity Operational acceptance testing Kraken market and service testing Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams. Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones. Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking. The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site. A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications , including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity. Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems. Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment. Excellent communication skills , with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action. Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties. A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously. The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly. A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality. A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving. A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end , rather than treating the software platform as a black box. A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function. Language: professional fluency in English . A second European language would be preferable. ⭐️ Bonus points Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial. Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources. A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA ) Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets. Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services. Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration. Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning. Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. •  Set and hold the creative bar. Shape visual direction across channels and make consistency and quality non-negotiable

•  Lead and develop the existing Marketing Design team, assess its capabilities and future shape, and determine where additional permanent, freelance or AI-enabled capacity is needed

•  Define the design requirements for intake, briefing, prioritisation, SLAs and review, working with Brand Operations and Marketing Operations to turn them into scalable processes

•  Design and direct high-quality visual and motion assets that bring the brand to life, personally setting the benchmark for the wider team

•  Build and present creative work to senior stakeholders, articulating rationale clearly enough to guide decisions

•  Manage a flexible pool of freelance and external creative partners to absorb peaks in demand

•  A track record of building and evolving brand systems across campaigns, products or businesses, including ownership of key visual directions

•  A standout portfolio showing strategic thinking, creativity and polished execution across visual design, motion, editorial, digital and social formats

•  Clear examples of work where you led or directed other creatives

•  Demonstrated AI design fluency, with evidence of AI-native production rather than occasional AI assistance: workflows you built, quality standards you set, output you shipped

•  Experience in fintech or financial services

•  Experience with sponsorship, partnership or event-led brand work at scale

•  Motion design depth, or experience directing motion specialists

•  Experience partnering closely with a product design function on a shared brand system

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Our teams play a vital role in making pet healthcare more accessible through innovation, operational excellence, and outstanding customer experience. 

 

 

 

 

 


How You'll Make a Difference

You'll report to the Managing Director and lead the supply chain for Pet Drugs Online (PDOL), giving the business one clear view of demand, supply, stock and risk. You'll own the sales and operations planning (S&OP) process and lead three managers, covering planning, stock, and our carrier and third party logistics (3PL) partners. The goal is easy to state and hard to achieve: the right stock in the right place at the right time, without losing sales or tying up cash in excess or obsolete inventory.

  • Run the monthly S&OP cycle from demand review through to the executive decision meeting, and chair the weekly reviews that keep the plan on track between cycles
  • Build one agreed demand forecast by product, category and time horizon, then track its accuracy and bias and challenge any assumption without evidence behind it
  • Turn the demand plan into a workable supply, purchasing, stock and warehouse capacity plan, making constraints, costs and the effect on customers clear before anything is approved
  • Set stock policy for each product segment, covering service levels, safety stock, reorder points and order quantities, with separate controls for fast and slow movers and for prescription, seasonal, short dated and critical lines
  • Hold overall accountability for stock accuracy and availability, working through the Stock Manager on counts, batch and expiry control, adjustments and fixing root causes
  • Manage supplier performance and own the commercial relationships with our carriers and 3PL partners, from contracts and service levels to capacity and contingency plans
  • Work with Commercial on ranges and promotions, with Finance to reconcile the plan to budget and working capital, and with Goods In and Warehouse Operations to keep inbound deliveries manageable
  • Build the team's capability, succession and reporting so the function spots problems early and doesn't have to rush orders through after the fact

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

We're looking for a driven, capable professional who brings:

  • Senior supply chain leadership experience, including direct ownership of S&OP, demand and supply planning, purchasing and inventory in a business with a large, varied product range
  • Deep practical knowledge of forecast accuracy and bias, inventory segmentation, safety stock, reorder logic, supplier lead times, service levels and working capital
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement, with the ability to put numbers on the choices between revenue, margin, availability, cost, cash and risk
  • Confidence chairing decision meetings with Commercial, Operations and Finance, challenging constructively and getting everyone behind one plan
  • A highly numerate approach, with the pragmatism to tighten control before perfect technology is in place
  • A calm, credible style and the willingness to raise uncomfortable facts early
  • A commitment to supporting our purpose and values

What We Offer Our Team 

 

  • Healthcare Cash Plan 

  • Cycle to Work scheme 

  • Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme 

  • Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you 

  • Discounted staff pet care 

  • Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers 

 

Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging 

At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are keen to hear from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions and would be happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments needed during the recruitment process.

  • Own annual and quarterly commercial planning, aligned with Corporate Strategy and FP&A. 

  • Define and evolve territory, segmentation and coverage models across regions and customer segments. 

  • Partner with the designated Finance business partner to translate commercial plans into agreed budgets and forecasts, challenging assumptions and ensuring financial plans accurately reflect commercial strategy, capacity requirements and expected performance. 

Quotas, Incentives & Pricing 

  • Develop quota methodologies and provide expert input into sales incentive design with Sales leadership, Finance and RevOps. 

  • Build pricing analytics and recommendations, partnering with Offering Management to inform and  evolve pricing models. 

  • Analyse realised pricing, discounting, margins, deal economics, exceptions and offer mix, identifying systemic trends and recommending changes that improve commercial performance and decision-making. 

  • Lead quarterly pricing reviews and track agreed pricing model improvements through implementation to measure commercial impact. 

  • Develop frameworks and decision criteria for evaluating complex commercial trade-offs across price, margin, growth, capacity, and strategic value. 

Commercial Insight 

  • Model cost, benefit, ROI/payback and key assumptions for headcount, technology, geographic expansion and route-to-market decisions. 

  • Analyse productivity, conversion, win/loss and commercial performance trends, identifying underlying drivers and translating findings into recommendations for senior leadership. 

  • Provide evidence-based recommendations on where and how the commercial organisation should invest and scale. 

  • Lead complex analytical work on new or ambiguous commercial questions where established methodologies or precedents may not exist. 

  • Evaluate external market, competitive and internal performance signals to identify implications for commercial strategy and planning assumptions. 

Must Have:

  • Significant experience in Commercial Planning, Strategy & Operations, Business Planning, FP&A, Revenue Operations or a similar analytical role, including experience advising senior leadership on complex commercial decisions. 

  • Exceptional analytical and financial-modelling capability. 

  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales economics, capacity planning and commercial productivity. 

  • Experience with territory, quota and incentive modelling. 

  • Experience analysing pricing, discounting and commercial models, and translating analysis into actionable commercial recommendations. 

  • Strong business-case and scenario-modelling skills. 

  • Ability to translate complex analysis into concise executive recommendations. 

We value:  

  • Experience supporting global commercial organisations spanning multiple regions, customer segments or routes to market. 

  • Experience supporting major growth, market-entry, organisational scaling or commercial transformation initiatives.

description: <p></p> <h3><strong>🚀 About the role</strong></h3> <p><strong>Career track:</strong> IC4</p> <p><strong>Unit:</strong> LX</p> <p>As Senior UX Researcher / Designer, you will play a vital role in understanding our learner audience. Mentorship: </strong>Passionate about sharing knowledge, mentoring peers to raise research maturity, and providing direct, empathetic feedback.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice to have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-Driven Experiences: </strong>Familiarity researching and designing for AI-mediated interactions, including balancing AI visibility, user control, and trust-building.</li> <li><strong>AI Tool Integration: </strong>Intentional and effective use of AI tools in your own practice for synthesis, prototyping, or exploring directions faster.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>💰Salary and benefits:</strong></h3> <p>💸£69,000 - £81,000 dependent upon experience</p> <p>🏖️ 33 days annual leave (Inclusive of bank holidays)</p> <p>🎄 3 gifted days off at Christmas</p> <p>💰 EMI Share Options Scheme</p> <p>🎓 Generous individual learning and training allowance</p> <p>⌚ Truly flexible hours to suit when you work best</p> <p>💻 Full home working set up and beautiful collaborative office space</p> <p>🚗 Free Leeds City Centre office parking</p> <p>🌴 Nomad working policy with family travel insurance</p> <p>🍼 Enhanced 26 weeks maternity and 4 weeks paternity (fully paid)</p> <p>🤍 Health cash plan (from glasses to massages)</p> <p>💸 6% employer pension contribution</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>📍Location:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Our beautiful office space in Leeds is our key hub for collaboration, and we love to get together in person. title: Senior Producer
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a Senior Producer to join the Live Game organisation supporting the MONOPOLY GO! team. This role is remote within the EU and will support our Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—through our work alongside talented colleagues and through our connection with millions of players around the world.</p> <p>MONOPOLY GO! is one of Scopely’s flagship mobile free-to-play franchises and one of the largest games in the mobile industry.&nbsp;</p> <p>With teams distributed across Barcelona, Sevilla, the United States, and other global locations, this role requires strong production leadership, excellent communication, and exceptional attention to detail.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Producer within the Live Game organization, you will oversee development across one or more live game workstreams, helping transform product strategy and creative goals into high-quality player experiences.</p> <p>You will manage development from early planning and team alignment through implementation, integration, QA, release, and live support. This includes coordinating concurrent initiatives, managing complex dependency chains, driving change request flow, and ensuring teams remain focused on delivering meaningful player and business outcomes.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds production role requiring both strategic thinking and tactical execution. You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management to deliver at the pace and quality expected of a global mobile live-service game.</p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end production lifecycle for assigned Live Game development workstreams, from discovery and planning through development, release, and post-launch support.</li> <li>Manage multiple concurrent initiatives with shared teams, resources, dependencies, and shifting priorities.</li> <li>Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into clear, executable development plans.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrated schedules, milestone plans, critical paths, risk registers, and dependency maps.</li> <li>Coordinate development across Product, Game Design, Engineering, Art, Content, Economy, QA, Localization, Analytics, Live Operations, and Release Management.</li> <li>Establish clear DRIs, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision points, and delivery expectations for major initiatives.</li> <li>Manage the complete mobile live-service development lifecycle, including design alignment, implementation, configuration, integration, QA validation, release readiness, live activation, and post-launch follow-up.</li> <li>Partner with Live Operations and Release Management to ensure development work is compatible with the LiveOps calendar, release cadence, player priorities, and operational requirements.</li> <li>Lead the change request process by assessing the impact of proposed changes on scope, schedule, capacity, quality, risk, and downstream dependencies.</li> <li>Drive prioritization and decision-making around change requests, communicate approved changes clearly, and ensure plans and systems remain aligned with the latest direction.</li> <li>Proactively identify blockers, bottlenecks, gaps in ownership, and risks to delivery. Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate with clear recommendations when necessary.</li> <li>Facilitate milestone reviews, sprint planning, production checkpoints, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.</li> <li>Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-through.</li> <li>Maintain accurate and current project information across Jira, Airtable, Confluence, and other production systems.</li> <li>Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence clearly to both senior leadership and development teams across the Barcelona and Sevilla hubs.</li> <li>Partner with Live Operations after launch to support issue triage, player-impacting investigations, post-launch actions, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Use player data, team feedback, and operational insights to inform prioritization and improve future development planning.</li> <li>Champion improvements to development workflows, production practices, tooling, and cross-functional collaboration across the Live Game organization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in game production, with significant experience in mobile free-to-play or live-service games.</li> <li>Proven experience managing the development and delivery of mobile game features, systems, content, events, or other player-facing experiences.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Live Operations, including high-frequency content delivery, live calendars, release cycles, remote configuration, QA validation, launch readiness, and post-launch support.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple concurrent development workstreams with complex cross-functional dependencies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of roadmap planning, milestone management, critical-path tracking, risk management, change management, and delivery readiness.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Engineering and technical teams, with an understanding of client/server dependencies, configuration, integration, and mobile release considerations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage dependency escalation, negotiate tradeoffs, and create accountability across teams.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations.</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership for the quality and accuracy of production information.</li> <li>Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Confluence, Google Workspace, or similar project-management systems.</li> <li>Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, from shaping a development roadmap to following individual deliverables through completion.</li> <li>A player-focused mindset and passion for building engaging, polished, and continuously evolving mobile game experiences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Ideal Candidate</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Is highly organized, structured, dependable, and comfortable operating in a high-volume Live Operations environment.</li> <li>Understands the realities of mobile free-to-play development, including rapid iteration, global releases, frequent content updates, live player impact, and operational precision.</li> <li>Drives outcomes beyond task tracking and status reporting.</li> <li>Anticipates problems before they become delivery issues.</li> <li>Communicates directly, diplomatically, and consistently across global teams and time zones.</li> <li>Creates accountability without unnecessary process or bureaucracy.</li> <li>Is comfortable challenging unclear plans, identifying gaps, and driving decisions.</li> <li>Can manage competing priorities while maintaining focus on the critical path.</li> <li>Brings sound judgment, energy, and a collaborative mindset to a fast-paced, globally distributed development organization.</li> <li>Cares deeply about both the quality of the player experience and the operational excellence required to deliver it.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Strategy Analyst
description: <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></p> <p>We are looking for a technically-minded individual with a deep personal interest in AI/ML to join the DMFI COO Office as a dedicated AI Strategy Analyst. This is not a traditional quant or engineering role — it sits at the intersection of investment workflows, data strategy, and applied AI, with a mandate to drive real adoption and measurable impact across our Macro &amp; Fixed Income platform.<br><br>We need someone who can get hands-on with training, datasets, prompt engineering, and implementation, while continuing to advocate for DMFI priorities with the platform AI team.<br><br>The ideal candidate is 3-5 years out of university, likely with a PhD or strong technical background (computer science, data science, computational finance, physics, engineering, or similar), who has a genuine base-case curiosity about AI and can grow into a leadership position as the function scales. We value intellectual horsepower and hunger over years of experience.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p> <p>AI Implementation &amp; Hands-On Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end implementation of AI tools and workflows for DMFI PMs and analysts — from scoping use cases through to production deployment and adoption tracking.</li> <li>Build, test, and refine custom prompts, skill libraries, and automated workflows tailored to macro/fixed income investment processes.</li> <li>Develop and maintain custom datasources (vectorised document stores, research embeddings, email ingestion pipelines) that PMs can query via SchonAI/Claude.</li> <li>Work with proprietary pod-level data, market data (Bloomberg, Citi Velocity, DTCC), and internal analytics to create AI-accessible datasets.</li> <li>Prototype and iterate on use cases: AI-driven research briefs, trade write-ups, behavioural bias detection, position analytics, and idea generation tools.</li> </ul> <p>Training &amp; PM Adoption</p> <ul> <li>Design and deliver training programmes for PMs and analysts — from prompt engineering fundamentals to advanced Claude Code sessions.</li> <li>Create playbooks, best-practice guides, and reusable templates that lower the barrier to AI adoption.</li> <li>Run regular "AI Lab" sessions, demo new capabilities, and build institutional knowledge across the platform.</li> <li>Track adoption metrics (usage rates, token spend, hours saved, model adoption) and report on ROI to senior management.</li> <li>Identify and address friction points — token budgets, workflow gaps, awareness issues — to drive consistent adoption.</li> </ul> <p>Data Strategy &amp; Dataset Management</p> <ul> <li>Map and catalogue DMFI's data landscape: what data exists, where it lives, and how to make it AI-accessible.</li> <li>Drive the ingestion and embedding of key data sources: broker research (email and platform), central bank transcripts, internal research notes, and PM communications.</li> <li>Ensure data quality, naming conventions, and governance standards for all AI-accessible datasets.</li> <li>Work with Technology to build and maintain data pipelines that keep AI tools fed with current, relevant information.</li> </ul> <p>Platform Liaison &amp; Priority Advocacy</p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary interface between DMFI and the central AI/Technology team — representing PM priorities, advocating for resources, and ensuring DMFI's roadmap items are appropriately prioritized.</li> <li>Participate in cross-strategy AI working groups, share DMFI use cases, and import best practices from other strategy sets.</li> <li>Translate business requirements into technical specifications that the AI engineering team can deliver.</li> <li>Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape (new models, tools, capabilities) and assess relevance for DMFI.</li> </ul> <p>Compliance &amp; Governance</p> <ul> <li>Ensure all AI-derived analytics and outputs have appropriate audit trails for compliance purposes.</li> <li>Work with Compliance to establish guardrails for AI usage in trading contexts.</li> <li>Maintain documentation of all active AI tools, datasets, and workflows.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>3-5 years post-university; PhD or Master's in a quantitative/technical discipline strongly preferred (Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computational Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).</li> <li>Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI — personal projects, open-source contributions, research papers, or equivalent evidence of self-directed learning.</li> <li>Hands-on proficiency with Python; experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace), LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), and data manipulation libraries (pandas, numpy).</li> <li>Familiarity with NLP concepts: embeddings, vector databases, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, fine-tuning.</li> <li>Comfort working with large datasets and building data pipelines (SQL, cloud storage, APIs).</li> <li>Interest in or exposure to financial markets — particularly macro/fixed income — is a strong plus but not required; we will teach the domain to the right technical candidate.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills — ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical PMs and translate vague business needs into concrete technical solutions.</li> <li>Self-starter mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, able to prioritise independently, and driven to ship tangible outcomes rather than just produce analysis.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego; able to work across seniority levels from junior analysts to senior PMs and C-suite.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Measurable increase in PM AI adoption rates across DMFI.</li> <li>At least 3-5 fully deployed, production-quality AI workflows generating demonstrable time savings or insight generation for PMs.</li> <li>Complete catalogue of DMFI datasets with clear AI-accessibility status and roadmap.</li> <li>Regular training cadence established with positive PM feedback.</li> <li>Clear prioritisation framework agreed with central AI team for DMFI-specific enhancements.</li> <li>Quantified ROI metrics linking AI usage to operational efficiency and/or investment edge.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Who we are</u></strong><strong>&nbsp; <br></strong>Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro &amp; Fixed Income.</p> <p><strong><u>Our Culture</u></strong><strong> <br></strong>At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.</p> <p><em>#LI-PW1</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Engineer - Human-Centric Technologies (Defence & Security)
description: <h3>The Role &nbsp;</h3> <p>We have an opportunity for a Principal Engineer working with a particular focus on our defence and security clients. You’ll join a team of talented engineers and scientists designing, building, and testing intelligent, human-centric systems. &nbsp;</p> <p>As one of the senior technical voices in the team, you’ll be architecting the technical approach on our projects, setting the technical bar for others, and helping shape the work we deliver. As well as hands-on research and engineering, you’ll spend time with clients, using your expertise to win new projects as well as deliver them. &nbsp;</p> <p>Much of our defence and security work requires security clearance, so we ask for it up front. You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us. &nbsp;</p> <p>We offer a flexible approach to hybrid working, although some of the projects you will be working on will require full-time working in the office. &nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>What you’ll be doing &nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Designing and developing human-centric intelligent systems: technical frameworks and architectures that perceive, reason about, and adapt to human state, behaviour, and intent in real time using multi-modal sensing and contextual modelling. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Designing, protocolling, and running human subject studies, conducting empirical data evaluation, and synthesising scientific insights to inform and back technology design. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Conducting deep literature reviews across experimental psychology, cognitive science, and human factors, translating complex concepts into actionable engineering requirements. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Acting as technical lead and architect on our larger, more complex projects, owning the technical solution and the value it delivers to the client. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your advice sought by colleagues. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Steering internal capability, research, and demonstrators that keep us at the forefront of technology and open up new conversations with clients. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentoring engineers and scientists and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people. &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Supporting and contributing to how the department works,
