title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
description: <h2>About us</h2> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, we believe the future of technology isn't just smart, it has agency. We're moving past passive tools and building human-centred digital services and products: systems that reason, plan, and act around the people who use them. Our work spans autonomous systems at the frontier of biology, sensing, and AI.</p> <p>We hire self-motivated builders, not ticket-takers. If you thrive in highly agile environments, can cut through ambiguity with first-principles thinking, and want to ship things that matter, this is the kind of place where you'll feel at home.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>You'll be working on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling problems no one else can solve.</p> <p>Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.</p> <p>You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.</p> <p>There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).</p> <p>Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.</p> <h2>What we ask of you</h2> <p>The examples below describe the core domains our AI Engineers own within the Digital Services team. We don't expect every candidate to have mastered all of these, but if you can demonstrate a strong combination of the following, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>AI System Architecture:</strong> Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.</p> <p><strong>Infrastructure &amp; Production Engineering:</strong> Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.</p> <p><strong>Rapid Client Prototyping:</strong> Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, rather than describing it in slide decks.</p> <p><strong>Domain Translation &amp; Integration:</strong> Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.</p> <h2>Indicators you'll be a good fit</h2> <p><strong>Applied AI Expertise:</strong> You have hands-on experience utilising multi-agent frameworks, long-term memory systems, RAG pipelines, vector/graph databases, and reasoning-loop patterns (such as ReAct and Chain-of-Thought).</p> <p><strong>Core Software Fluency:</strong> You possess strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, coupled with practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You know that great agents still require rock-solid software foundations.</p> <p><strong>High Tolerance for Ambiguity:</strong> You are energised by uncertainty and shifting targets. You treat changing requirements as a normal part of frontier work, and you know exactly when to ship a rough prototype to learn quickly versus when to slow down for architectural rigour.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Disciplinary Communication:</strong> You can seamlessly navigate the gap between code and reality, collaborating with clients, roboticists, and scientists to clearly deliver the "art of the possible."</p> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p><strong>Variety of work: </strong>Projects spanning biotech, finance, robotics, and beyond. No two engagements look alike.</p> <p><strong>Continuous learning: </strong>A mentoring and learning package shaped by your goals, backed by squad-based knowledge sharing across the company.</p> <p><strong>Engineering autonomy: </strong>A free hand in choosing the right tools and processes. We trust your engineering judgement.</p> <p><strong>Access to world-class experts: </strong>You'll share a building with biologists, roboticists, electronics engineers, and mathematicians. Few places let you tap that range of expertise on a single project.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid working environment:</strong> We're flexible about where you work on a day-to-day basis. We also love the energy of collaborating in person, so we’d love you to be in Cambridge for key meetings.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. Rigor & Organization: You believe structured methods and precision are the keys to operational success. €</strong></li> <li><strong>Mutuelle d’entreprise</strong></li> <li>Accès à&nbsp;<strong>Wellpass</strong>, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être</li> <li>Accès Bleue</strong></li> <li>Accompagnement proposé par&nbsp;<strong>Action Logement</strong></li> <li>Programme de recommandation interne</li> <li>Des opportunités régulières de formation, d’apprentissage et de développement professionnel</li> </ul> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <ol> <li><strong>Échange avec un recruteur</strong>&nbsp;– Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations</li> pratique permettant d’évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain</li> </ol> <h2>À propos de SumUp</h2> <p>Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d’accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu’ils font de mieux.</p> <p>Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd’hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs —&nbsp;<strong>Founder’s Mentality, Team First et We Care</strong>&nbsp;— nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.</p> <p>SumUp est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. raw.title: Commercial(e) Terrain Nantes
raw.description:
Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné : les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway accompagnée d'une carte de frais professionnels, remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Technical Writer
description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence. In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes. Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander) Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update Interface & System Specifications Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines Operational & Field Documentation Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates Client-Facing Delivery Documentation Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements Support the preparation of raw.title: Technical Writer
raw.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

  • Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients

  • Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences

  • Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version

  • Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines

Operational & Field Documentation

  • Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides

  • Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems

  • Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises

  • Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions

Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management

  • Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication

  • Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes

  • Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication

  • Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately

  • Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates

Client-Facing Delivery Documentation

  • Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements

  • Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices

  • Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators

  • Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications

Candidate Profile - Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides

  • Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products

  • Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used

  • Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators)

  • Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

The Trade-In service enables customers to sell their old devices (smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, Back Market’s network professional refurbishers. En tant que Solution Engineer, vous êtes le pont technique entre nos clients et la plateforme : vous participez aux ateliers client, vous captez les besoins, puis vous utilisez le développement assisté par IA (Claude Code, Windsurf et notre outillage d'agents interne) pour configurer, intégrer et étendre la plateforme InsideBoard, souvent dans la même semaine. Vous orchestrez des agents IA sur un écosystème interne bien documenté (surface d'API, automatisation n8n, conventions pensées pour les agents). L'IA écrit la majeure partie du code ; votre travail consiste à savoir ce qu'elle fait, à vérifier qu'elle fait la bonne chose, et à l'arrêter quand ce n'est pas le cas. Et vous portez la relation client sur le volet technique. Vos missions Face au client (environ 50 %) Animer des ateliers de cadrage et de spécification avec des clients grands comptes (en français et en anglais), du kickoﬀ aux comités de pilotage (COPIL). Transformer les réunions en livrables actionnables : spécifications fonctionnelles, matrices de statut, wireframes, guides d'intégration, guides utilisateur, comptes rendus avec décisions validées. Défendre des arbitrages face au client : configuration standard ou développement spécifique, vision cible ou solution pragmatique, et assumer la recommandation. Répondre aux revues de sécurité et aux questions de due diligence technique ; rédiger des analyses de cause racine en cas d'incident de production. Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %) Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags. Construire et maintenir des workflows d'automatisation n8n : webhooks, tâches planifiées, synthèses générées par IA, pipelines de contenu RAG, alerting d'erreurs centralisé vers Slack. Scripter des opérations de données en Python ou TypeScript : migrations en masse avec discipline dry-run et rollback, audits de licences, rapports d'engagement, échanges Excel/CSV/SFTP avec les DSI clientes. title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
description: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations. Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database. The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria. Task 3 – Application to flight tests. The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms. Starting date : 01/01/2027 Profile and application: PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python/Matlab). References: [1] Pereira, A. & Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, J. Sound Vib. , doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2021.116633. [2] Roger, M. & Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, J. Sound Vib. , 453, 328-354. LMFA contacts: Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob LVA contact: Quentin Leclère (LVA, INSA Lyon) Funding: European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna. Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst. Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services. Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen. Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert – von der technischen Spezifikation und Architektur über API-Design und Entwicklung bis hin zu Betrieb, Incident Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Performance, Stabilität, Security und Compliance und stellst sicher, dass technische Risiken früh erkannt, bewertet und bewusst adressiert werden. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich im Engineering-Alltag und hilfst deinem Team dabei, AI sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll für Entwicklung, Testing, Dokumentation und Code Reviews einzusetzen. So arbeiten wir Unsere Teams verantworten ihren Produktbereich komplett: Architektur, API-Design, Entwicklung, Betrieb, Incidents, Security, Compliance. Die kommerziellen KPIs gehören dazu. Wir reden mit Kunden, fahren zu ihnen raus, testen unsere Lösungen dort im Betrieb. Verantwortung endet nicht am Merge-Button. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Du baust etwas auf, statt ein bestehendes Team zu verwalten. Du bekommst einen klar abgegrenzten Verantwortungsbereich und die Freiheit, ihn zu gestalten. Du arbeitest direkt mit CTO und Product Manager und kannst technische, produktbezogene, kulturprägende und kommerzielle Entscheidungen tatsächlich beeinflussen. Du siehst die Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen unmittelbar – im Produkt, im Team und im Geschäft. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei Kund*innen, Gärtner*innen und Partner*innen vor Ort Diese Stellenbeschreibung ist bewusst meinungsstark und setzt hohe Standards. Was dir an einzelnen Punkten noch fehlt, können wir gemeinsam entwickeln – entscheidend ist, dass du das Mindset und die Bereitschaft mitbringst, in diese Rolle hineinzuwachsen. Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.


So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.

  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern

  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.

  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.

  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

title: Applied ML Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in France. As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering. You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products. The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences. You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate. You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users. The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack. It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust. Accountabilities Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models. Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses. Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required. Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility. Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows. Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion. Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations. Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses. Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation. Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve. During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations. Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface. Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why. Requirements: Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers. Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility. Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages. Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation. Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate. Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users. Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests. High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently. Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions. Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus. Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous. Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial. Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus. Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable. Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage. A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend. Benefits: Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product. End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences. Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques. A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems. Fast-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional collaboration. Opportunity to translate cutting-edge research into practical, measurable, and user-accessible products. The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust. Location: Romania. Additional compensation, flexibility, healthcare, and other benefits may be provided according to the partner company's employment package and local arrangements. raw.title: Accountant
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

  • Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

  • Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

 

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Month-end close: own the end-to-end closing cycle across multiple legal entities; push pre-formatted journal entries into NetSuite, ensure completeness and accuracy, and deliver on schedule every month (target: J+5)

  • Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

  • Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

  • Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

  • Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed

⭐️ Qualifications ⭐️

Experience and technical skills

  • 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

  • Languages: full fluency in French and English

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

  • Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

  • Reliable and detail-oriented: you deliver on time, every time, and keep a clean audit trail

  • Autonomous and self-directed: you don't wait to be told what to do next; you manage your priorities, make decisions independently, and know how to take a step back to distinguish what truly matters from day-to-day noise

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

  • Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

  • Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate

For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range.

 

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

     

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • 🤘A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts. Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care , bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang. Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession. La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.   🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi  Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de : Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH. Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain. Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être. Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.   👉 Tes futures missions  Engagement clients Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka... Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH. Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés. Engagement utilisateurs Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés. Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care. Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app... Notoriété et thought leadership Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care. Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients. Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.   L'entraide est très importante chez Moka. De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin... 📇  Tu es la personne idéale si  Tu as au moins  2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne. Tu es à l'aise à l'oral , et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants. Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie , organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives. Tu fais preuve de  professionnalisme  et d’un vrai  sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées. Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design  (nous utilisons  Figma ). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo , c’est un vrai plus. Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche. Tu disposes d’un  bon niveau d’anglais , te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles. 🚀  En nous rejoignant tu vas  Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte. Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire. Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail.  Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care. Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin. 🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi Accès à M oka.Care   : app, sessions individuelles, formations mensuelles et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités. Work-life balance : 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois). Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop. Cagnotte May : 1500 euros net/an (125 euros net/mois). Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour. Gymlib , pour faire du sport; Politique de 7 semaines de congés payés / RTT. Leeto , pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE. Mutuelle :  SideCare. 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo. Mac ou windows? Tu choisis, on veut que tu te sentes à l’aise. Rémunération : Package annuel brut entre  43 200 euros et 47 200 euros annuel brut (fixe + cagnotte May) , selon nos grilles de rémunération en interne. Cette fourchette est donnée à titre indicatif : le positionnement précis sera défini en fonction de ton expérience, de tes compétences et de ton adéquation au poste, afin de garantir cohérence et équité interne. 🎤  Processus de recrutement Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré, pensé pour te projeter dans ton futur quotidien de travail. 30 minutes de screening pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations. Une première étude de cas pour évaluer tes compétences, et approfondir ton expérience. Une seconde étude de cas  pour te mettre en situation face à des enjeux client concrets. Un entretien Values fit  pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront. Offre  et  reverse interview:  l’opportunité pour toi de nous poser toutes les questions importantes pour prendre ta décision. Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe. Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.
